terminals.name: neon-proxy
terminals.description: Neon serverless WebSocket proxy that tunnels the app's database traffic to local Postgres (NEON_LOCAL=true).

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; export BETTER_AUTH_URL="${BETTER_AUTH_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"; export CORS_ORIGIN="${CORS_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3001}"; export VITE_SERVER_URL="${VITE_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"; export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"; export CANTIARA_LISTEN_HOST="${CANTIARA_LISTEN_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"; bun run dev
terminals.description: Turborepo dev servers: web (http://localhost:3001), API server (http://localhost:3000), and Fumadocs (http://localhost:4000).
